The '''Uggernaught''' was the nickname for an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]]-made [[Droid/Legends|droid]]<ref name="Ugnaught Engineering" />  or [[Walker/Legends|walker]].
==Characteristics==
The early versoin of an Uggernaught was a tripedal droid armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster cannon]], a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grapple]], a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrover]] and a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="Ugnaught Engineering" /> 

The Uggernaught walker was a modified [[Exoskeleton|exoskeleton]] manufactured by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]]. It had an open cockpit where the driver and operator&mdash;or gunner&mdash;were seated. The gunner was positioned towards the rear of the walker, behind a protective plate.

Designed as a load-lifting exoskeleton, maintenance Uggernaughts featured [[Plasma torch/Legends|plasma torches]] and [[Magnetic Projector|magnetic projectors]] for lifting extremely heavy materials.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
Uggernaughts were used by Ugnaught [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] in the ruins of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Third Galactic War|Third Galactic War]]<ref name="Ugnaught Engineering" />

Uggernaughts were employed throughout [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] on construction platforms.<ref name="CSWE" />
